annotations.title: Buscar decisor e contatos da empresa

description: For small businesses (a school, a market, a clinic), finds in one run who decides there (name and role, with the public source of each fact), that person's mobile, WhatsApp and e-mail, and the business's general mailbox (personal data). Takes 1 to 25 entries in people, looked up 5 at a time. Each business is identified by its name and city, its CNPJ, its site domain or a phone it publishes. First it checks this workspace (people sheets, campaigns and kept briefs): a value already saved comes back free, with savedIn naming where it was saved; refresh true skips that check. Otherwise it asks Nock's data sources one after another and stops at the first that finds it. value holds what was found of the decision maker and the contacts. Each item is charged only when found; a decision maker that comes only from the Receita's partner registry is free, and the WhatsApp is not charged again when it is the same number as the mobile. Nothing is written into a sheet or a campaign. Returns one entry per person or business in the order sent (index), each with person (whose it is), status found, not_found or error, value and creditsCharged, plus the totals found, notFound, failed and creditsCharged. not_found with sourcesUnanswered means some sources did not answer in time and a later try may find it; error means no source answered. The same entry sent twice is looked up once (sameAsIndex). Costs WhatsApp: 6 a 15 créditos por número achado (at most 46 credits per item found). Nothing is charged when it is not found, the lookup fails or the value was already saved. A lookup can take up to about a minute per entry.

people.description: Who to look up, 1 to 25 entries, each with what is known of them.

cnpj.description: The business's CNPJ (Brazilian company registry number), when known.

companyDomain.description: The business's site domain, when known.

location.description: The business's city (and state), with companyName.

phone.description: A phone number the business publishes, when known.

refresh.description: True skips what this workspace has saved and looks the value up outside again.
